title: The Flu
text: You wake up feeling like a suspect's alibi: crooked and unreliable. Detective, you're sick.

chooses.label: Work through it (energy x2 until cured)
Rest for 24h (then energy x0.8 for 3 days)

title: Anonymous Letter
text: "Drop the case and $300 is yours. No one will ever know." A photo of a stack of bills is attached.

effects.reason: You took the bribe. The case was buried, the artefact now decorates a yacht in Dubai, and your boss framed your formal reprimand. On your desk. Where everyone can see it.

title: Lost Wallet
text: A fat wallet on the pavement. $80 inside. No ID. Plenty of witnesses, though.

chooses.label: Turn it in to the police

title: Pickpocket!
text: Someone bumps into you on the metro. Your pocket is suddenly $50 lighter. The suspect was faster than your last case.

title: A Whisper in the Dark
text: A man in a trench coat (unsurprisingly) offers to sell you a tip about your current case. $100. Cash only.
